earnings.title: Earnings calendar
earnings.no_stocks: No stocks on the watchlist (crypto has no earnings). Add tickers on the **Profile** page.
earnings.no_dates: No earnings dates found for the watchlist.
earnings.no_figures: No reported figures for this date.
earnings.price_reaction_caption: Price reaction spans the print: last close before the date vs first close after, so it always contains the gap regardless of pre/post market timing.
earnings.no_match_filters: No earnings dates match the selected filters.
earnings.calendar_legend: Red chips = report within 7 days. Green ▲ / red ▼ = past beat/miss — click for the result overview. Blue cell = today.
earnings.quarter_pending: The income statement for this quarter isn't published yet — revenue, margins and the GAAP result appear once the filing lands.
earnings.no_quarter_data: No quarterly income statement available for this ticker.
earnings.sub_revenue: What the quarter billed, and where the trend sits
earnings.tip_ttm: Sum of the last four reported quarters.
earnings.sub_margins: Share of revenue, change vs the same quarter last year
earnings.margins_caption: Margins are computed from the filed income statement (line / revenue), so a one-off gain or charge lands in them unsmoothed.
earnings.sub_gaap: As filed on the quarterly income statement
earnings.tip_tax_rate: Tax provision / pretax income for the quarter.
earnings.tip_shares: Diluted weighted-average count. More shares dilute per-share value; fewer (buybacks) lift it.
earnings.sub_eps: Headline vs GAAP diluted, and the surprise track record
earnings.tip_headline_eps: As published by the earnings feed — for most companies an adjusted (non-GAAP) figure, which is what the estimate is set against.
earnings.tip_gaap_eps: Diluted EPS as filed on the income statement. The gap to the headline figure is the adjustment.
earnings.outlook_caption: Company guidance is not in any free data feed. These are sell-side consensus figures: the bar with the mean marked on it spans the analyst low-high range, so a wide band means the street disagrees.
